summary: Regenerate all self-signed certificates on RPM installs by setting aap_service_regen_cert=true in [all:vars] and running the installer, then verify each component's cert against ansible-automation-platform-managed-ca-cert.crt with openssl verify.
questions: How do I renew the self-signed certificates in AAP?
How do I verify the controller certificate against the managed CA?

answer_card.title: Renew self-signed certs (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[all:vars]
aap_service_regen_cert=true
```
Run the installer, then verify, for example:
```bash
openssl verify -CAfile ansible-automation-platform-managed-ca-cert.crt /etc/tower/tower.cert
openssl s_client -connect <CONTROLLER_FQDN>:443
```
